jobs.title: Sales Support Specialist
jobs.description_text: Our story began with a passionate idea that we could change the world.... And to be honest, we’ve never stopped believing that... In 1986 it was a simple concept that microbiology teamed with innovation and clinical contribution could eliminate an issue that was profoundly impacting the healthcare industry – HIV acquired through needle-stick injuries. In Australia, we lived out our dream. Investing years into R&D to create the safest containment system in the world and taking on the industry status quo to petition for higher standards in sharps protection, we witnessed an 80+ percent reduction in disposal-related needlestick injuries nationwide. And then we kept going... The Sales Support Specialist helps create a smooth and efficient experience for both customers and sales professionals. This role provides essential support throughout the sales cycle, from preparing quotes and managing customer information to coordinating internal resources and resolving inquiries. The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, enjoys collaborating across departments, and takes pride in delivering outstanding service and results.

Overview DNA Genotek products are marketed worldwide and support thousands of customers as they achieve breakthroughs in genomic and microbiome research, in diagnostics laboratories, in the pharmaceutical industry, in companion animal genomics and in personalized medicine. This job posting is to hire for an existing vacancy. Quality Control Specialist personnel executes written procedures that include evaluation of raw materials, finished products, equipment and product performance in compliance with guidelines established by OraSure Technologies and regulatory agencies. The base salary range for this full-time position is 45,000-75,000. This is a one year contract position.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst
jobs.description_text: About The Role: Drivemode is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to turn vehicle telemetry and user behavior data into reliable insights that guide product improvement. This is a hands-on individual contributor role within Engineering, working closely with the Analytics Product Manager and Product and Engineering teams. You’ll work from a centrally governed, pseudonymized, preprocessed data layer (silver layer) in Snowflake, building the intermediate and analysis-ready models, dashboards, and analyses the company relies on. You’ll help translate business questions into well-defined problems and recommendations, especially around user behavior and UX improvements. Beyond delivering analyses, you’ll help establish a data-driven culture by proactively identifying opportunities, improving data quality and analytical capabilities, and working across organizational boundaries to turn insights into measurable product improvements.

jobs.title: Senior Legal and Internal Control Specialist
jobs.description_text: Our Mission: Driving technology always feels old. Not by a little bit. We believe vehicles can be a thousand times smarter, safer, and more connected to the world around us, and our mission is to see it happen. In 2019, we joined forces with Honda as their first startup acquisition, and now we’re expanding our vision into building the future of connected vehicles for millions of people around the world. Why Drivemode: Join Drivemode for an exciting startup environment and a vibrant culture that combines impactful work, competitive compensation, and excellent benefits. By becoming a part of our team, you'll contribute to a crucial mission that revolutionizes the way people engage with vehicles, addressing both business needs and the world's environmental challenges. This presents an exceptional opportunity to be at the forefront of innovation and drive Honda's success in the automotive market. About The Role:The Senior Internal Control & Legal Administration Specialist is responsible for driving internal control and legal administration activities for a company with offices in both Japan and the U.S., while serving as a key liaison between the organization and its Japanese parent company.

You’ll partner closely with product managers, designers, and engineers at both Drivemode and Honda to bring clarity and confidence to design and product decisions. jobs.title: Accounting Manager
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Eko Health builds devices and software that help clinicians detect heart and lung disease earlier. We’re looking for a Manager, Cost Accounting & Procure-to-Pay, remote in the US on Pacific hours, to own two things at the center of our business: what it costs us to put a device in a clinician’s hands, and how we pay for everything that gets it there.This is a build role. Reporting to the Corporate Controller, you will set Eko’s costing methodology and defend it to our auditors, own inventory valuation and reserves, run landed cost end to end, close COGS each month, and run procure-to-pay from purchase order to payment. You will partner with Supply Chain, Sales Operations, and FP&A, and your margin analysis will reach the executive team. You inherit a working foundation and a lot of room to make it better.A few things make this role unusual. Eko does not run a factory: devices are built by contract manufacturers and bought as finished goods, so cost is purchase price plus landed cost, and inventory sits with partners we cannot walk into. Hardware is sold alongside subscription software, so the margin story is blended. And this is a hands-on manager role with no direct reports to start: you provide review oversight to our offshore transactional team while personally owning the higher-judgment accounting, reconciliations, close, and conclusions. If you like building both the methodology and the reconciliation behind it, you will thrive here. Essential Functions Cost

Position Overview CLO Virtual Fashion에서 3D Design & Implementation Specialist를 채용합니다. [안내] 본 포지션은 패션 산업(브랜드, 벤더 등)에서 4-6년의 실무 경험을 갖춘 분들을 위한 채용입니다. CLO 소프트웨어의 기존 숙련도는 요구하지 않으며, 입사 후 새로운 IT 기술을 빠르게 습득하여 기존 패션 실무 지식과 결합할 수 있는 역량(Tech Savviness)을 중점적으로 평가합니다. CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 CLO 소프트웨어 전문가로서 패션/디자인/패턴에 관한 지식을 바탕으로 CLO 유저를 교육하고 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. 아울러, 유저의 니즈를 가장 먼저 이해하여 3D 프로세스가 효과적으로 접목될 수 있도록 전문적인 컨설팅을 진행합니다. 이처럼 CLO의 3D Design & Implementation Specialist는 유저가 CLO를 더 효율적이고 가치있게 사용할 수 있도록 컨설팅, 교육, 서포트하는 역할을 수행합니다. Hiring Process [서류 검토] → [1차 인터뷰] → [CLO Software Test] → [2차 인터뷰 (+Reference Check)] → [처우 협의] → [최종 합격] (1차 인터뷰 합격자에게는 2차 면접 전, CLO 사전 학습용 교육 자료 및 임시 라이선스가 제공됩니다. 2차 면접 시 진행되는 테스트는 기존의 CLO 숙련도가 아닌, 새로운 소프트웨어를 빠르게 습득하는 학습 능력과 패션 구조에 대한 이해도를 평가하기 위한 과정입니다.) To Apply 이력서 및 경력기술서 1부 (필수) 지원동기가 담긴 자기소개서 (필수) 본인의 담당 업무 및 참여 프로젝트가 기술된 포트폴리오 (선택) (CLO를 직접 다룬 경험이 없더라도, 참여하신 프로젝트 및 업무 경력을 확인하기 위해 포트폴리오 제출을 권장합니다.)

jobs.description_text: About Haven Safety: Haven Safety AI is building the enterprise learning intelligence layer for safety. Co-founded with The AES Corporation and AI Fund, the venture studio founded by Andrew Ng, Haven helps high-risk organizations learn faster from what goes wrong so they can prevent what comes next. Haven works alongside existing EHS enterprise systems to improve how organizations investigate, assess, and learn from incidents. INVESTIGATE guides evidence synthesis, timeline development, multi-threaded causal analysis, and corrective actions. ASSURE continuously reviews completed investigations for evidence quality, causal coverage, guideline adherence, and CAPA strength. LEARN reasons across incident history to surface recurring control failures, repeated corrective-action patterns, CAPA debt, and emerging signals. The platform combines current incident evidence, company knowledge, historical cases, and an industry knowledge graph. A coordinated team of specialized AI agents examines evidence, controls, engineering factors, procedures, regulations, training, and organizational history, then produces one traceable assessment for human review. Customers have reported an 80% reduction in root cause analysis labor time using Haven. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Maga

jobs.title: 3D Computer Vision Researcher – Arlington, VA
jobs.description_text: Advance 3D Vision Research from Algorithms to Open Source Applications. In this position, you’ll research and develop algorithms for photogrammetry, camera calibration, registration, and 3D reconstruction from images and video. Current projects emphasize aerial and satellite imagery, with opportunities to adapt these capabilities to new challenges and data domains such as underwater imagery and synthetic aperture radar. Your work will contribute to open source applications and frameworks including TeleSculptor, KWIVER, and Danesfield. You’ll also explore how 3D vision can support broader computer vision problems such as object detection and tracking, change detection, super resolution, and video compression. Kitware partners with government R&D agencies, branches of the U.S. military, members of the Intelligence Community, and commercial organizations ranging from startups to Fortune 500 companies. You’ll have opportunities to collaborate directly with customers, participate in field tests and demonstrations, publish novel work, and apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence approaches to real-world national security challenges.

jobs.title: Annotation Specialist
jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms. As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. Work availability will ebb and flow based on project needs, and a set number of hours each week is not guaranteed. The position requires flexibility to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when project needs require it, including work in a specialized facility. This position will also require obtaining the necessary government clearances.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Comptable général sénior H/F
jobs.description_text: Tu as envie de travailler dans un environnement bienveillant qui avance vite ? 5ème fournisseur français en 10 ans, Octopus Energy est un fournisseur d’énergies renouvelables qui agit comme un véritable fer de lance pour la révolution électro tech. Comment on fait ? On ne peut pas révolutionner le monde en travaillant comme tout le monde On essaye de ne pas trop se prendre la tête, ici on évolue dans un environnement sans trop de process ni trop de règles. Le plus important, ce n’est pas seulement de suivre le mouvement, mais de le créer. On ne veut pas créer des clones d’entreprise. On te veut toi, avec tes talents, tes perspectives et tes compétences uniques. Pourquoi ce poste ? Octopus Energy France connaît une forte croissance sur ses segments B2C, B2B et B2G, et sa fonction Finance se structure en parallèle : migration récente d’Odoo vers NetSuite, automatisation de la chaîne fournisseurs, interfaçage avec les plateformes de facturation, harmonisation avec les standards du groupe au Royaume-Uni. Nous cherchons un·e comptable senior capable de prendre en main un périmètre critique (marge brute et fiscalité énergie), de le fiabiliser et de le faire évoluer. Plus qu’un·e exécutant·e, tu seras celui ou celle qui identifie les problèmes, en comprend la cause et met en place des solutions durables.

jobs.description_text: About the Role The GNC team at Pivotal develops the flight control and navigation software for our aircraft, including the Helix family, using model-based design in MATLAB and Simulink. You will trace requirements to our control system models, build out an automated mission-level simulation test framework and its test suite, add unit tests, and automate coverage reporting and enforcement in our CI/CD pipeline. You will work closely with the GNC engineers who own the control laws, state machines, and estimators, and with the systems engineers who own the requirements. The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with the MathWorks verification toolchain on safety-critical aerospace software, and understands control systems well enough to write meaningful tests for them. This is a fully remote contract position.

jobs.title: Senior Frontend Engineer
jobs.description_text: OverviewThe AppLogic Team builds core software for the Graykey platform, which Law Enforcement and Government Agencies use to extract data from mobile devices. You'll work alongside our UX Design Team, turn their work into an interface that's fast, reliable, and easy to build on, and set the structure and conventions the rest of the team follows. The UI is a mature, server-rendered application built with plain JavaScript and Jinja templates, with CI/CD and unit tests in place. Examiners use it every day, so the job is steady improvement in place: better structure, better performance, and better data, one change at a time. jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: Every dataset at Spotify, from the data behind creator royalties to the signals powering recommendations, is registered, published and traced through systems our team builds. We're the source of truth for what data exists at Spotify, where it lives, who owns it, and how it flows from one pipeline to the next. These systems sit on the critical path of the platform. Data teams use them every day to publish and find data, and other platform teams build on them for access, retention, governance and incident response. That means our work is judged on correctness and reliability, because every system built on top of ours is only as good as the metadata we provide. This is a backend role focused on data management, working on the problems at the core of any large data platform: running a data catalog that stays accurate at scale, capturing lineage across batch and streaming workloads, managing schemas as they evolve, and guaranteeing that consumers only read complete data. We build on open standards like OpenLineage and Apache Iceberg, and define the internal standards for naming, storage and metadata that the rest of Spotify builds against. As the platform takes on new storage technologies and new kinds of data assets, those standards and the systems behind them have to evolve with it, and you'll help decide how.

jobs.title: Backend Engineer - Data Platform
jobs.description_text: LilEngine is leading the Lakehouse, a company-strategic effort to make Apache Iceberg a first-class citizen in Spotify's data ecosystem. We're building it in close collaboration with Google, on open standards, so that different kinds of data are queryable the same way and teams can bring the right engine, from BigQuery to Dataflow to Trino, to the job. The work has two parts. Hecate enables Iceberg for the Parquet datasets that already exist across Spotify, so teams get the benefits without rewriting their data. Alongside it, we're building the foundations of a new Lakehouse architecture that lets workflows write Iceberg tables natively. We're shipping the MVP this cycle, and you'll help shape what comes next. We also own BigQuery for all of Spotify. Thousands of engineers, data scientists and pipelines depend on it every day, which puts us on the critical path for storing, finding and querying data. We're judged on reliability, cost efficiency and how quickly we unblock users when something breaks. This backend role sits where open table formats, cloud data warehouses and processing engines meet.
